scalars.scalar_value: Professional level experience providing complex administrative support to a high-level executive.

items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Seven (7) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus three (3) years of Executive level administrative experience or equivalent relevant experience.
Professional level experience providing complex administrative support to a high-level executive.

The Physician Group is the Ambulatory arm of UC San Diego Health. It includes the clinical, financial, and operational performance of outpatient care services. Working with leaders from experience, compliance, quality, and strategy and finance, the Physician Group ensures that ambulatory operations meet the needs and requirements of patients, physicians, staff and the community. Excellent performance is assured by managing access, quality, finance, and service-oriented goals in over 100 clinics and 1,600 team members.Involves providing timely and highly organized administrative oversight for executives, including the coordination of communications and pertinent data among a group of the executive's subordinate management staff. Performs and/or oversees special projects or assignments that are highly sensitive or complex in nature, requiring a high level of independence and initiative in execution and implementation. Handles details and oversees work of a highly confidential and critical nature to support the executive on matters of significance. Responsible for scheduling and calendar management. Other duties as assigned.
While not required, a cover letter is highly recommended when applying to this position.
Organize tasks, prioritize and work effectively in an environment with multiple interruptions, while maintaining an organized work space.
Demonstrated technical proficiency, including but not limited to Excel, PowerPoint, Visio/Lucid, Word, etc.
Process Improvement training – yellow belt equivalent.
Strong knowledge of English grammar, spelling, punctuation and sentence structure/formats, demonstrated skill in composing correspondence.
Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills, including diplomacy, tact, and flexibility.
Proven ability to interact with all organizational levels and to communicate effectively and professionally both in person and via phone.
Ability to present a positive impression in person, on the telephone and through e-mail.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
Ability to anticipate executive’s needs, solve problems independently, and clear roadblocks before they arise.
Demonstrated emotional intelligence skills with strong situational awareness and adaptability to manage shifting priorities under high pressure.
